title: RemoteCaptureEnvelope
description: Envelope describing a capture that originated on another device, handed to Windows ingestion (design doc section 7.2). Mirrors the C# DTO MemoryTimeline.Core.DTOs.RemoteCaptureEnvelope. Capture metadata comes first; the artifact section carries the integrity data ingestion must verify before creating a queue item.

captureId.description: Globally unique, device-generated capture ID. Ingestion is idempotent on this value.

timezoneId.description: IANA timezone identifier at capture time, e.g. America/Toronto.

localOffsetMinutes.description: UTC offset in minutes at capture time, e.g. -240.

userNote.description: Optional free-text note attached at capture time.

tripId.description: Trip the capture belongs to, when applicable.

location.description: The single location fix the device attached at capture time (the sync contract's LocationContext, carried on CaptureChangePayload.location since v1.5). Kept on the capture row as columns; never turned into a named place and never written to the Windows sync outbox.

horizontalAccuracyM.description: Horizontal accuracy of the fix in metres, as the device reported it.

headingDegrees.description: Direction of travel in degrees, as the device reported it.

speedMps.description: Speed in metres per second, as the device reported it.

clientSchemaVersion.description: Version of this envelope schema the client wrote.

artifactId.description: Device-generated audio artifact ID; the receiver mints one when absent.

originalFileName.description: File name of the artifact on the originating device.

mediaType.description: MIME type of the audio artifact, e.g. audio/mp4.

expectedByteLength.description: Declared artifact size in bytes; verified against the resolved file.

expectedSha256.description: Declared lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the artifact bytes; verified before ingestion succeeds.

storageLocator.description: Opaque locator understood by the receiver's artifact resolver. Phase 0 resolves local file paths; Phase 1 replaces the resolver with a sync-service download client without changing this contract.
